body:
I’ll test the four DIN/ISO programs on our iTNC 530 programming station first. The station runs NC software `606425 004 SP20`. Our physical Fehlmann Picomax 55 runs `340490-03`.

I’ll report the station result for each file, including the block and the control message if the station rejects it. I can run the programs on the Fehlmann later to check them on `340490-03`.

I tested the four DIN/ISO files from `c5f4e6f94` on our iTNC 530 programming station. It runs NC software `606425 004 SP20`. I used the original bytes and loaded each file as `VMC_3-AXIS.I` in a separate folder.

| Program | Station result |
| --- | --- |
| `drill_peck` | The station marked `N100 G205` with `ERROR =` on import. A repeat gave the same result. Changing only `Q208=FMAX` to `Q208=+60` in a diagnostic copy let the station read the full block. I filed #3102 for the post defect. |
| `tap_plate` | All 17 lines matched on readback. Test Run reached `STOP REASON: block END PGM or M02`. |
| `contour_plate_with_hole` | All 78 lines matched on readback. Test Run reached the same program end. |
| `pocket_zigzag_plate_with_island` | The importer returned exit code 1. Readback showed `N990` followed by the program footer. The first missing block was `N1000`. This is consistent with the demo station’s 100-block limit. The full 116-line program still needs a test. |

The tapping and contour logs identified the selected programs and recorded no numbered alarm. Both graphics panes stayed blank and showed `ERROR`. These runs confirm NC program completion. Stock removal remains unverified.

I can repeat the tests later on the physical Fehlmann Picomax 55. Its control runs `340490-03`.

I tested the remaining pocket blocks on our iTNC 530 programming station (`606425 004 SP20`). I split the original file at `N590`, where the tool retracts after the first depth pass. Both files fit within the demo limit.

- Pass 1 kept the original header through `N590`, then used the original shutdown blocks from `N1120` through the footer.
- Pass 2 kept the original header through `N70`, then used `N600` through the footer. This preserved the move from `N990` to `N1000` and every remaining block.

The station returned all 64 lines of each file unchanged. Both Test Runs reached `STOP REASON: block END PGM or M02` without a numbered alarm in the run log. Together the two runs covered every original block, including `N1000` through `N1140`. The graphics pane stayed blank and displayed `ERROR` in both runs, so stock removal remains unverified.

The original 116-line file still awaits a continuous run. I can test it later on the physical Fehlmann Picomax 55, which runs `340490-03`.
